source_read: Blue Diamond Garden Centres, Our Calorie-Counted Menus: https://www.bluediamond.gg/our-restaurant-menus-calorie-counts/{breakfast,lunch-menu,sunday-lunch-menu,drinks} (the patisserie page shows no dish cards); 143 card placements, 132 distinct 640 x 720 card pictures (combined sha256 171e9f5ffdf6bc09ea0a77c3dcad1d04346fb2910dd997d6115050ff61e5c9ae); robots.txt of www.bluediamond.gg disallows only newsletter folders; about 45 garden centres in England and Wales (the /our-locations/ pages of its sitemap)
not_verifiable: which garden centres serve each dish (the page says menus and prices may vary by location); no allergen information is published with these menus
notes: The figures exist only inside the pictures. Machine read: tesseract on the title band and on each calorie circle (cut out by colour), at two enlargements. Human read: every one of the 143 card placements was read by eye on annotated contact sheets, and every calorie circle a second time on sheets of the circles alone at full size; the by-eye readings were then compared with the OCR: 89 cards agreed exactly (name and figures), 48 differed or were doubtful and are fixed in the script's CONFIRMED table by the card's SHA-256 (so a changed picture stops the run); OCR alone misread 21 figures (e.g. Tomato 51 read as 1, Garlic Ciabatta 569 as 969, Roasted Seasonal Vegetables 544 as 944, Three Meats 1596 as 596), which is why nothing is taken from OCR without the eye check. Final check: all 125 published items equal the by-eye reading of their card. Same printed name on different dishes is kept apart by section and menu (Croque Madame 726 breakfast special vs 1278 brunch plate; Three Egg Omelette - Cheese & Mushroom 976 with chips vs 766 without); the two American Style Pancake Stack cards are told apart by the V mark printed on the berry version. No alcoholic drinks are on these menus (the drinks page is hot drinks, summer soft drinks and milkshakes; Summer Drinks are marked limited time). Vegetarian (V/VG) badges on the cards are not turned into tags.
